brand_vibe: Warm, soft, feminine boutique nail studio. Photo set is dominated by natural daylight shots of finished nails (nude/blush gel, soft coral, lilac, mint, red) with gold rings, floral fabric and everyday settings (car, sweater, lap) rather than a styled salon interior. No selfies or owner portraits found in the usable photo set; one branded graphic (eucalyptus wreath monogram card, 'NAILS BY KIARA') used only as the small nav/footer logo, never as a gallery tile. Palette chosen: warm terracotta/copper-rose, a hue-rotated derivative of the light-v2 (Lash Bloom) skeleton's rose/plum palette, distinct from both frozen skeletons, to match the nude/warm-light aesthetic of the real photos.

palette.method: Hue-rotated every skeleton accent/orb/shimmer/dark-band/CTA color by a fixed delta (rose/plum hue ~332 deg -> terracotta hue ~20 deg) with a slight saturation boost on accent tones; merktop-badge gold left untouched (protected).
